featured_reviews.name: Shishir Deshpande
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent place for FreshCatch especially if one lands up there around 8/8:30 am or thereabouts. The fish comes off the boats around 5 am or so and lands up at the Versova Village Fish Market by 8 am.
One can really bargain here and get fresh fish for reasonable prices, having said that ‘reasonable’ is really relative as seafood due to over fishing and environmental challenges has become quite expensive.
A must visit for seafood lovers for a home cooked meal!!

featured_reviews.name: Gupta Rohit
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a nice place for fish/prawns buying. Market starts at 7 AM. You have to be tough negotiator here. Do not be in rush to buy, there are plenty of options, be careful while buying, there are chances you may be robbed of old fishes. You can get all the items chopped and cleaned, there are seperate people who cleans it up for you. I came across the cleaning chopping lady Gauri, if you are a noob in buying she can help you with good buy. If you have more time you can visit Bhau cha Dhakka but than it takes more to travel and you will have to be early bird and experienced to negotiate and have good find.

featured_reviews.review_text: Versova koli wada is nice with culture fisheries local womens selling fish while their husband or male person going for fishing  at sea. As they called them sagar devta as well as their  typical local language koli sounds so good.

featured_reviews.name: Shishir Deshpande
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent for fresh sea food and sea food lovers who like cooking. A wide variety of fresh catch is available with fish like Pomphrets, Prawns / Shrimps, Crabs, lobsters et al.
The fresh catch comes every alternate day from the aversive jetty where the trawlers arrive every alternate days or so.
It’s a historical place in its own way.

featured_reviews.name: asif sharief shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good place for holesale fish in all variety

featured_reviews.name: Salim Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Fish market at Andheri west Versova. You need to have good bargain skills to buy anything from here. The sellers are quite humble and polite,  but also be ready to get insulted if you are trying to bargain at a very low price below the expected lowest price and when you irritate them. Don't get emotionally carried away with the stories the sellers might try to sell. They will never sell even at their cost price. And the term 'bony karo' will be heard a lot. Don't get carried away. They will never give away unless they make profits. Generally the fishes are quite fresh and good to eat. The quantity matters for a good deal.

featured_reviews.name: Manish Dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a good place if you need to buy fish in large quantities. You will find fresh & good quality of Prawns, Surmai, Pomfret, Bangda & Bombayduck. Make sure to be there between 8AM to 9:30AM. Because after this time it is the small retailers who sell there. And if you want to get the fish cleaned : de-shelling the prawns, cleaning Bombayduck etc. you can get it done from small errand boys and girls who will do it for 30-50 Rs. Also be prepared to dare thru some fish slurry on the floor and ofcourse the STRONG  stench of fish.

featured_reviews.name: Abhir Doifode
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently dined at Fresh Catch and was impressed by the quality of the food and the exceptional service. The butter garlic crab was cooked to perfection and the garlic butter sauce was rich and flavorful. The crispy bombil was a delightful surprise with just the right amount of seasoning. The pomfret harabhara was a highlight of the meal, perfectly cooked with a delicious blend of spices and herbs.

The portions were generous, and we left feeling satisfied but not overly full. The service was outstanding, with attentive and knowledgeable staff who went out of their way to make us feel comfortable and happy.

Overall, Fresh Catch is a must-visit for seafood lovers. The food is delicious and the service is exceptional. I highly recommend it and can't wait to go back!

featured_reviews.name: Jhuma Banerjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
These guys are a ripoff. Never thought that behind the curtain of English speaking hosts warming the chairs in their air-conditioned castle,  they actually subvert to unfair market practices.
I have been their customer from the time they opened shop in Sher E Punjab.  Used to trust them for the quantity they give. But to my horror discovered that they were taking us for a royal ride all along.
Recently got myself a weighing scale. I ordered for 1.2kg of Ravas but when I got it was only 730gm. They tell me that almost 500gm is a wastage. The lady at the shop enquired as to how I know of the tare and when I told her that I have a weighing scale,  she got on the offensive stating that she's in the business for so long and we as customers don't know anything of fishing business.
So they have been doing this all along. Better to visit the local machiwala and buy it from him. And yes, thanks for cheating us all these years #Freshcatch

featured_reviews.review_text: These guys deliver stale prawns and surmai. I have brought from them many times due to the lack of a seafood store around but it has always been disappointing. Now i have stopped buying from them.

featured_reviews.name: Rakesh Vasani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a very good experience in the store. The owner (Rakshit Kotian) helped with not just selection of the aquarium but also guided me with detailed information on how I should set it up and what would be the best combinations for my Betta. Unlike any other store, Rakshit actually stopped me from over-buying, asking me to set things up slowly as I am a first timer.

The store has a lot of variety of fishes, different breeds of fishes, shrimps, etc. All well kept and managed.

The greatest thing there though, is the large almost 6 feet tank that he has set up with plantation and fish in it. Very beautifully made. Has different plants and weeds in it. With multiple variety of fishes. Amazing to look at.

Would highly recommended the store, the location is a little difficult to find, but besides that, everything you need is available.

featured_reviews.name: Pranay Sakre
featured_reviews.review_text:
Finally found my best place

Minara Masjid is a mosque located in the city of Mumbai, India. It was built in the 18th century by a businessman named Siraj ud-Daula Muhammad Khan. The mosque is situated in the bustling area of Mohammad Ali Road, which is known for its lively street markets and food stalls.

The Minara Masjid is an impressive structure with tall minarets and a large dome. It has a spacious prayer hall and can accommodate a large number of worshippers at once. The mosque is open to people of all faiths and is a popular destination for tourists who come to admire its architecture and learn about Islamic culture.

In addition to serving as a place of worship, the Minara Masjid is also actively involved in social and charitable work. The mosque runs several programs to provide aid to the needy and support education and healthcare initiatives in the local community.

featured_reviews.name: Urvashi Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had recently rescued two 2-month-old kittens and consulted a veterinarian, who prescribed Bolfo/Notix powder for flea treatment. Unfortunately, the product was unavailable at Arya pet store, and the staff recommended an alternative, assuring us that it was a “medicated” flea treatment suitable for the kittens.

What they failed to disclose—or possibly did not realize—was that the product was toxic to young kittens, resulting in severe toxic shock shortly after application. The kittens began exhibiting serious symptoms, including foaming at the mouth and extreme drowsiness, which prompted an emergency visit to the veterinarian. It was a distressing experience for us and the couple who supported the rescue.

Thankfully, the kittens received prompt veterinary care and are now in recovery. We are closely monitoring their condition and remain hopeful that they will make a full recovery without long-term neurological effects.

This incident has been a difficult and eye-opening experience, emphasizing the importance of using only vet-prescribed products, especially with young or vulnerable animals. We sincerely hope no other rescued or domestic animals face a similar situation due to misinformation or inappropriate product recommendations

I've visited so many art galleries. But this one was so different. The ambience this one provides is so different from other art galleries in Mumbai.

It is located in Byculla. It's not very far from Byculla station. You can even go walking or just take a taxi outside railway station.

Exhibition inside was beautiful. They also have a pond inside which has swans and frogs. It looks very pretty during the day. Interiors of this gallery is too good.

Everyone should visit this gallery atleast once. Loved it!

featured_reviews.name: Kajal Gaitonde
featured_reviews.review_text:
It is a wonderful space, actively engaging in creating Art Awareness for public. One should try to participate in their Art-centric activities on a regular basis.
The pictures that I have posted is another gallery in the same vicinity, a little ahead from there. If you visit Nine Fish AG, do not miss visiting this beautiful, glass structure Art Gallery too.

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Pandya
featured_reviews.review_text: Was here for an exhibition. It has a huge hall for the main set of artworks and a smaller room at the back for more. Can easily accomodate larger artworks/ sculpture as seen in photo. Acoustics are great to host a talk/ presentation. Lighting and display are done with finesse and it has a class of its own . It's located in a peaceful compound with a few more galleries to explore.

featured_reviews.name: Bansri Chavda
featured_reviews.review_text: Ninefish is retreat for lost old souls , with art and the premises that speak of books, art. Poetry , antiques, thick vegetation, old pond room, ceramic studio , print studio ..... and it has more dimensions! Explore for yourself

featured_reviews.name: Rekha Krishnan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Beautiful space for exhibiting. The architecture of the gallery is interesting. The old mill structure has been retained, with careful alterations. The walls with their rough texture create an 'old world' environment.
The different rooms are used to display a variety of work.
The location is a bit difficult to find, since it is inside the Great Eastern Mills compound.

featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text: This is one of the hidden art galleries in Mumbai. Aesthetic ambience with vintage things. Great.

featured_reviews.name: Pottery by Mangala
featured_reviews.review_text: An excellent gallery space to showcase your creative work be it art , photographs or ceramics . . I have been to some wonderfully curated exhibitions in this gallery .
